name: DeepSeek Harness
description: Run the reviewed community DeepSeek Harness image in Docker.

community-container-image.title: Community Docker image
community-container-image.description: This reviewed image is maintained by the community and is not an official DeepSeek distribution. Redeven pulls only its approved digest.

service-api-credentials.title: Keep API credentials inside the service
service-api-credentials.description: Configure API keys inside DeepSeek Harness after it opens. Redeven does not receive, copy, or log those keys.
